folder.label: Folder
folder.button: Destination folder: {path}. Click to change it.
folder.tooDeep: This folder is very deep: titles will come out very short, or the download may fail. Pick one closer to the root.
settings.styleHint: The themed style uses the colours of albaro.dev and changes with the season.
settings.notificationsHint: A system notice when the queue is done (once, however many there were). Not shown while the window is in front.
settings.limitHint: Shared among the downloads that can run at once.
settings.cookiesHint: Only for content that asks you to sign in. Firefox works best; Chrome, Edge and Brave may fail. A cookies.txt exported from the browser (with an extension) works with all of them: the app uses a copy and never touches your file.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.close: Close the history or the card
downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.empty: Paste a link to get started
downloads.clearHint: Removes the finished, failed and cancelled downloads from the list. No file is deleted.
history.label: History
history.empty: No finished, failed or cancelled downloads yet.
history.loadFailed: The history could not be read.
history.more: Showing the {count} most recent. Narrow the search to see others.
playlist.numbered: Number the files in the list's order
playlist.noneAvailable: None of the videos in this list can be downloaded.
playlist.empty: No videos were found in this list.
options.subtitlesGuess: Embedded in the videos of the list that have them.
options.name: File name
name.title: Title
warn.av1: Best-quality MP4 uses AV1 for this source: older devices, or Windows without the AV1 extension, may not play it. "MP4 compatible" plays everywhere.
warn.noH264: This source has no H.264: the compatible MP4 will keep its original codec.
warn.webmToMkv: This source cannot go in a WebM (it uses H.264/AAC): it will be saved as MKV, without re-encoding.
warn.lossy: Converting to MP3, AAC or Opus loses quality compared with the original.
warn.noGain: FLAC and WAV do not improve an already compressed source: the file gets bigger without sounding better.
download.live: Live streams cannot be downloaded yet.
row.revealFailed: The file is no longer on the disk.
error.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection.
error.extractorBroken: This site has changed and can't be read yet. An update usually fixes it.
error.unavailable: The content isn't available: it may be private, deleted or blocked in your country.
error.noSpace: There's no space left on the destination disk. Free some up or pick another folder.
error.jsRuntimeMissing: The component YouTube needs (Deno) is missing.
error.invalidUrl: The link isn't valid: only http:// and https:// addresses work.
error.loginRequired: This content requires signing in. You can use your browser's cookies in the settings and try again.
error.cookiesUnavailable: The cookies could not be read. If it is a browser: close it completely (also in the background); recent Chrome, Edge and Brave encrypt their cookies in a way yt-dlp cannot always decrypt on Windows, so try Firefox or a cookies.txt file. If it is a file: check that it is still there and that it is a cookies.txt.
error.alreadyQueued: This download is already in the queue.
error.folderUnavailable: The destination folder cannot be used. Pick another one.
error.playlist: This link is a playlist or a channel.
error.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard is empty or has no text.
error.notLink: The clipboard doesn't contain an http(s) link.
error.tooLong: The copied text is too long to be a link.
update.available: A new version of AlbaRo Downloader is available: {version}.
update.busy: Finish or cancel your downloads to install it.
update.failed: The update could not be installed. You can try again.
playlist.truncated: there are more: only the first are shown
detail.copyHint: Copies the detail without your user name or the parameters of addresses
history.clearHint: Deletes the history for good (finished, failed and cancelled downloads). Downloaded files are not deleted
history.clearFailed: The history could not be deleted.
